- Claude connection preflight reuses a valid existing Claude login and skips browser login when the current quota check succeeds.
- A permission-only verification can request access to the exact Claude Code credential without launching a redundant login flow.
- Authentication errors may start the provider-owned CLI login, while network errors stop safely without login; usage and quota remain independently fallible.
- Settings explains upfront that the existing sign-in is checked first and macOS may request access to Claude Code credentials.
- The first macOS permission grant remains controlled by macOS and is not claimed gone or avoidable.
- Codex and Cursor behavior remains unchanged. Automated coverage exercises the remaining authentication, permission, network, serialization, and lifecycle branches.
- Needlbar remains local-first: no account, telemetry, credential duplication, browser-cookie fallback, or hosted sync is added.
